Evel Knievel was one of the greatest entertainers of all time. Bold statement, yes. But not only was he one of the biggest superstars of his day, he pioneered a style of attention marketing that has basically become the norm in today’s social media landscape. He was, however, a deeply flawed man, riddled with contradictions. Today we examine the many rises and falls of Evel Knievel.
